title: Zero-shot Deep Learning with Multi-Objective Optimization Improves Thermostability of Zearalenone Hydrolase and Xylanase
relevance: Directly demonstrates multi-objective (structure + sequence model) optimization for enzyme thermostability. Shows ABACUS-R + MSA Transformer achieves +8C Tm with >95% activity retention.
key_finding: Integrating structure-based (ABACUS-R) and sequence-based (MSA Transformer) models via multi-objective MCMC achieves significant thermostability with preserved activity.

title: Energy-guided combinatorial co-optimization of antibody affinity and stability (LAffAb)
relevance: Combinatorial library of 7000 antibody variants with up to 9 mutations co-optimizing affinity and stability. Demonstrates practical multi-objective combinatorial protein engineering.
key_finding: Combinatorial library of up to 9 mutations achieves up to 30-fold affinity gains while co-optimizing stability.

title: An integrative approach to protein sequence design through multiobjective optimization
relevance: Multi-objective protein sequence design framework integrating multiple scoring functions. Provides methodology for Pareto-based protein optimization.
key_finding: Multi-objective optimization framework for protein design integrating diverse scoring functions.
